claim.statement: At the January 15, 2026 GA announcement, GitLab said Duo Agent Platform was available to Premium and Ultimate customers on GitLab.com and Self-Managed, while GitLab Dedicated availability was planned during the 18.8 release cycle.

source.title: GitLab announces Duo Agent Platform general availability
source.locator: Availability paragraph and GitLab 18.8 release-cycle statement

lifecycle.reason: Launch-day offering scope retained separately from later availability.

limitations: The announcement applies to the Agent Platform release cycle and does not identify an exact backend revision for any offering.
Planned Dedicated availability is not evidence that Dedicated was available on the announcement date.
unknowns: The date and service revision at which Dedicated availability became effective during or after the 18.8 cycle are unknown.
The selected offering, tier, namespace settings and add-on state of any execution are unknown.

relationships.note: The launch announcement distinguishes available and planned offerings; current documentation lists all three. The catalog preserves the different time scopes.
